notes: The three focal runs open the same authenticated private conversation, observe an authenticated remote typing broadcast in product UI, prove explicit stop removal, prove expiry without a stop broadcast, and observe the product composer emitting both typing and stop through the real transport.

The peer uses the production Supabase Realtime topic and Phoenix protocol with heartbeat, holds credentials only inside its isolated browser context, and closes without writing Chat rows. All reports assert that the message set is unchanged and databaseMutation is false.

Android now schedules one bounded reconnect after Closed, Error or failure, invalidates callbacks from superseded channels, clears stale remote state, and cancels pending retries on background, network loss or conversation exit. Lifecycle transitions, callbacks, events and retry timers share one monitor, so a stale callback cannot pass a generation check and then republish presence after disconnect. Focused JVM tests cover deduplication, cancellation and a deterministically suspended stale Subscribed callback; the API 35 product run passed.

iOS serializes URLSession callbacks, timers and typing state on Dispatchers.Main.immediate. The Simulator XCTest proves expiry before opening the keyboard, then explicit stop, then exact local draft typing and idle stop observed by the authenticated peer.

Web/Wasm keeps the startup splash outside the product shell until session resolution, preventing stale underlying pixels and requiring the exact composer plus remote typing semantic anchor before accepting the observation.

All three accepted reports were produced from the clean exact Product SHA 5a77ddfd685e7ca5fc2b04e69febd156cd84c348 after the Android callback serialization fix. They record that same head, workingTreeDirty=false and no database mutation. No evidence is inferred from an earlier dirty or pre-commit tree.

The draft fast lane detected stale Main.kt capability hashes after the initial product commit. Commit 91074a2b refreshed all eleven affected references, and the capability-matrix contract passed 22/22 before the final evidence runs.

Independent review of the prior head found a check-then-act race between Android realtime callbacks and lifecycle disconnect. Product SHA 5a77ddfd removes that race through atomic monitor serialization and adds a deterministic regression test; the renewed exact-head independent review remains required before promotion.

The failed Android attempts are retained in the run history: one found no emulator, and one isolated an Espresso 3.6.1 incompatibility with the preview API 37 InputManager before app launch. The accepted product execution uses the repository's API 35 gate environment.

The failed iOS attempts are retained in the run history: the internal disk first exhausted space during linking; the isolated external build then omitted the required Hyper-V raster init script and the seeder stopped because Metal is unavailable; the first corrected raster execution reached the product indicator but missed the expiry deadline once. The same corrected command was repeated once after targeted app termination and passed fully. The accepted report comes only from that final clean Product SHA execution with the documented Hyper-V CPU raster dependency selected.

This closes the documented remote typing-presence limitation for the focal authenticated private Chat path. It does not declare a global SCR-CHAT GO, durable offline typing replay, exhaustive multi-party stress, expired-session behavior or all network fault timings.
